subgrupo: Glúteo médio · glúteo mínimo · tensor da fáscia lata
movimento: Sentado na cadeira abdutora, com o glúteo e as costas encostados no encosto e o tronco quase em pé, os joelhos dobrados a 90°, os pés apoiados nos apoios dos pés e as almofadas encostadas do lado de fora dos joelhos; o encosto regulado para o quadril ficar em cima do eixo de cada braço da máquina (o ponto em que o braço gira) e as mãos segurando os pegadores ao lado do assento, com os braços quase esticados. Começa com as pernas juntas e abre as pernas empurrando as almofadas para fora, cada coxa girando para o lado até uns 40°, onde se sente um alongamento confortável no quadril; volta devagar, controlando, até as pernas ficarem juntas de novo. Só o quadril mexe: cada perna vai inteira, com o joelho parado a 90° e o pé no apoio, e o glúteo, o tronco e as costas ficam parados, encostados no banco.

cinesiologia.plano: transversal (horizontal): com o quadril dobrado ~90° e a coxa deitada, abrir e fechar as pernas é a coxa girando em volta da vertical que passa pela articulação do quadril — a abdução do quadril com o quadril dobrado; o eixo de cada braço da máquina fica nessa vertical
cinesiologia.articulacoes: quadril (abdução na ida, de ~3° a ~40° cada coxa, com o quadril dobrado ~87°; adução na volta); joelhos parados a 90°; tornozelos parados e neutros, os pés chapados nos apoios; coluna neutra e parada, encostada; ombros, cotovelos e punhos parados, as mãos nos pegadores
cinesiologia.agonistas: glúteo médio e glúteo mínimo (eGym M10 Abductor: Primary muscles "Gluteus medius", "Gluteus minimus"; ExRx: Target "Hip Abductors", com "Gluteus Medius" e "Gluteus Minimus" na lista), em contração concêntrica na abertura e excêntrica na volta; com o quadril dobrado a atividade do glúteo médio não muda (Fujisawa et al. 2014: "The IEMG of the GMed did not change with increases in hip flexion angle.")
cinesiologia.sinergistas: glúteo máximo (a parte de cima) e tensor da fáscia lata (eGym M10: Secondary muscles "Gluteus maximus", "Tensor fasciae latae"); piriforme e obturador externo (ExRx: Synergists "Piriformis", "Obturator externus"). Sentado, com o quadril dobrado, o glúteo máximo trabalha mais e o tensor menos que em pé (Fujisawa et al. 2014: "the IEMG of both the UGM and LGM increased significantly with increases in hip flexion angle, whereas the IEMG of the TFL decreased significantly"; Farias et al. 2026, na própria máquina: "increased hip flexion significantly decreased TFL activation while maintaining moderate GMed activity")
cinesiologia.estabilizadores: sem estabilizador importante (ExRx: Stabilizers "No significant stabilizers"); as mãos seguram os pegadores só pra firmar o corpo no banco (eGym: "Hold the side handles for stability."; Farias et al.: "The arms rested lightly on the machine's lateral handles to aid stabilization without contributing to the movement.")
cinesiologia.fases: concêntrica (abre as pernas empurrando as almofadas pra fora até um alongamento confortável no quadril — eGym: "Press your legs outward against the resistance until a comfortable stretch is felt in your hips.") e excêntrica (volta devagar, controlando, até as pernas ficarem juntas — eGym: "Return to the starting position in a controlled motion."); no estudo de EMG, 1 s em cada fase (Farias et al.: "at a steady cadence of one second per phase")

referencias: ExRx.net — Lever Seated Hip Abduction (https://exrx.net/WeightExercises/HipAbductor/LVSeatedHipAbduction, lido na cópia do Internet Archive de 06/03/2026; o site responde 403 direto): classificação "Utility: Auxiliary", "Mechanics: Isolated", "Force: Push"; Preparation: "Sit on machine with legs inside of side pads. If available, place heels on foot bars. Release and pull lever brace to position legs together. Engage lever into locked position. Lie back and grasp bars to sides."; Execution: "Move legs apart as far as possible. Return and repeat."; Comments: "Sit in machine with leg levers apart. Use release lever to position legs together in starting position."; músculos: Target "Hip Abductors (listed below)", Synergists "Gluteus Medius", "Gluteus Minimus", "Gluteus Maximus", "Piriformis", "Obturator externus", Stabilizers "No significant stabilizers"

ExRx.net — Weight Training Tips, "ROM Criteria" (https://exrx.net/WeightTraining/Tips, cópia do Internet Archive de 29/10/2025): "Consider setting a range of motion (ROM) criteria on those exercises which have a peak tension curve (e.g. shrug, hip abduction, calf exercises, etc.). During a warm-up set with a light weight, take note of the angle or height the moving body segment or the position of the apparatus at full range. All subsequent workout repetitions should reach this benchmark without accelerating the weight through this harder portion of the exercise."

eGym (fabricante) — Smart Strength, exercícios: M10 Abductor e M11 Adductor (https://knowledge.egym.com/en/smart-strength/work-out-on-smart-strength/exercises, lido em 06/10/2026): M10 Abductor — Primary muscles "Gluteus medius", "Gluteus minimus"; Secondary muscles "Gluteus maximus", "Tensor fasciae latae"; "Sit with your glutes against the backrest and your back straight."; Seat variation: "Sit upright with your feet on the footrest closest to your body." / "Sit against the backrest with your feet on the further footrest."; "Place your feet on the footrests and position the outside of your thighs or knees against the pads."; "Hold the side handles for stability."; "Start with your legs close together."; "Press your legs outward against the resistance until a comfortable stretch is felt in your hips."; "Return to the starting position in a controlled motion." (M11 Adductor, a mesma máquina do outro lado: "Place your feet on the footrests and position your inner thighs or knees against the pads."; "Start with your legs open until a comfortable stretch is felt in your inner thighs.")

Farias AM, Leal LCP, da Rocha RWG, Krause Neto W. Not All Hip Abductions Are Equal: The 45° Paradox Between Gluteus Medius and Tensor Fasciae Latae. Research Square, preprint (sem revisão por pares) de 06/01/2026, doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-8523653/v1 (texto lido em 06/10/2026) — EMG na cadeira abdutora a 45°, 90° e 135° de flexão do quadril: "In the 90° hip flexion condition, participants sat upright with their trunks vertically, and their hips and knees flexed at approximately right angles. The pelvis was pressed against the backrest, and the torso stayed in contact throughout the entire exercise. The abduction movement involved moving the thighs laterally from a neutral position to the participant’s maximum comfortable abduction, then returning them to midline under control."; "The arms rested lightly on the machine's lateral handles to aid stabilization without contributing to the movement."; "Participants were instructed to perform the concentric (abduction) and eccentric (adduction) phases at a steady cadence of one second per phase"; "increased hip flexion significantly decreased TFL activation while maintaining moderate GMed activity"; o próprio estudo diz que "the maximum hip abduction amplitude for each participant was not measured"

Fujisawa H, Suzuki H, Yamaguchi E, Yoshiki H, Wada Y, Watanabe A. Hip Muscle Activity during Isometric Contraction of Hip Abduction. J Phys Ther Sci. 2014;26(2):187-190. doi:10.1589/jpts.26.187 (texto completo, PMC3944285): "Results indicated that the IEMG of both the UGM and LGM increased significantly with increases in hip flexion angle, whereas the IEMG of the TFL decreased significantly."; "The IEMG of the GMed did not change with increases in hip flexion angle."; na introdução: "Basmajian and DeLuca reported that the GM was active during extension of the thigh at the hip joint, lateral rotation, abduction against heavy resistance with the thigh flexed to 90°, and adduction against resistance that holds the thigh abducted."

Cheatham S, Hanney WJ, Kolber MJ. Hip Range of Motion in Recreational Weight Training Participants: A Descriptive Report. Int J Sports Phys Ther. 2017;12(5):764-773 (texto completo, PMC5685413, lido em 06/10/2026): 200 praticantes de musculação, amplitude passiva do quadril; abdução medida deitado — "The subject was positioned supine on the examination table with legs extended."; "The examiner passively abducted the subject's leg as far as possible, without causing any aberrant pelvic motion, and then took the measurement." — tabela 2 (todos): abdução 42,6 ± 11,3° (direita) e 43,2 ± 12,3° (esquerda)

Medidas da máquina — Hammer Strength Select Hip Abduction (Life Fitness, HS-HAB: https://lifefitness.com/en-gb/catalog/strength-training/selectorized/hammer-strength-select-hip-abduction, lido em 06/10/2026): "The ratchet mechanism allows exercisers to adjust in 10-degree increments, and the kneepads and dual foot positions provide leg support around the knees."; "Size (L x W x H): 61" x 26" x 55" (metric cm: 155 x 66 x 140)"; Instructional Placards: "Easy-to-follow instructions illustrate proper use and muscles trained; Axis of rotation marked with red indicator to help cue correct alignment"; Titan Fitness Selectorized Hip Abductor Adductor Machine (https://titan.fitness/products/selectorized-abductor-adductor-machine, tabela de especificações lida em 06/10/2026): "Back Pad Dimensions: 12-in. x 17.5-in.", "Seat Pad Dimensions: 13-in. x 14-in.", "Adjustable Seat Depth: 3.5-in.", "Six leg bar positions (0°, 15°, 30°, 45°, 60°, and 75°)". A altura do assento (0,54 m), a almofada do joelho (20 × 14 × 6 cm), o apoio do pé (30 × 13 cm) e os tubos são escolha da fábrica (não achei ficha de fabricante com essas medidas)

ACE e NSCA: a biblioteca de exercícios do ACE não tem a cadeira abdutora (só a "Standing Hip Abduction", outro exercício) e não achei o texto da NSCA sobre ela aberto em nenhuma fonte que deu pra ler — não usados

checagens.pes_no_chao_motivo: sentado na máquina os pés ficam nos apoios dos pés, presos nos braços que giram (Hammer Strength: "the kneepads and dual foot positions provide leg support around the knees"; eGym: "Place your feet on the footrests"), não no chão; quem confere os pés são as zonas dos apoios dos pés e a altura acima do chão abaixo

angulos.fonte: eGym — M10 Abductor ("Start with your legs close together."); ExRx — Lever Seated Hip Abduction ("position legs together in starting position"): as coxas abrem 3° (juntas e paralelas, as coxas musculosas do boneco entravam uma na outra perto da virilha)

ExRx — Lever Seated Hip Abduction ("Move legs apart as far as possible."); eGym — M10 Abductor ("until a comfortable stretch is felt in your hips"); Farias et al. 2026 (preprint), condição de 90° ("to the participant’s maximum comfortable abduction"); 40° fica logo antes da abdução máxima passiva de praticantes de musculação (Cheatham et al. 2017: 42,6°/43,2°, medida com o quadril esticado)

Farias et al. 2026 (preprint), condição de 90° ("their hips and knees flexed at approximately right angles"); Hammer Strength ("the kneepads and dual foot positions provide leg support around the knees": o pé vai junto com a almofada)

angulos.fonte: o pé fica no apoio que gira junto com a almofada do joelho (Hammer Strength: "the kneepads and dual foot positions provide leg support around the knees"): a perna vai inteira, a canela não tomba pra dentro nem pra fora (o joelho_valgo, medido na linha quadril–tornozelo de quem está em pé, não serve com a coxa deitada)
